name: 🐱 Don't Wake The Retro Cats!
desc:
Shh... Steal from sleeping Retro Cats! 🤫😾

Sneak around and steal cats while they are sleeping! 😴
Run away when they wake up and they start chasing you! 🏃‍♂️
Survive and collect as many cats as possible! 🐈
Level up your cats to become rich! 🤑

Make sure to like the game and join our group for more updates!
